components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one move to make now. Flat campaign blue.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0f172a, 0 0 0 4px #60a5fa; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #3d63c7; color: #f8fafc; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4a6fd0; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The light alternate in a pair, such as cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; color: #1e3a8a; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fafc 0%, #e0e7ff 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.95), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 12px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); transition: background 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #e6ecf7 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #fff, inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 6px 16px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tertiary (Glass) Button
components.description: Default menu and list button: translucent slate glass with a hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-tertiary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; color: #cbd5e1; background: rgba(148,163,184,0.07); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(148,163,184,0.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04); transition: background 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-tertiary:hover { background: rgba(148,163,184,0.16); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(148,163,184,0.32), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-btn-tertiary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Selected tab is a primary fill; idle tabs are faint glass.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; background: #0f172a; padding: 12px; } .ds-tab { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; color: #cbd5e1; background: rgba(148,163,184,0.05); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(148,163,184,0.14); transition: background 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(148,163,184,0.12); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(148,163,184,0.28); } .ds-tab-on, .ds-tab-on:hover { background: #3d63c7; color: #f8fafc; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Glass card sitting flat on the frame.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(96,165,250,0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(239,246,255,0.10); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { color: #f8fafc; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; } .ds-card-meta { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Panel-ink dialog with header rule and footer tray.
components.html:
Esemény
A kampány új szakaszba lépett.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: 400px; background: #161e30; border: 1px solid #4462aa; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f8fafc; overflow: hidden; } .ds-dialog-head { padding: 12px; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; border-bottom: 1px solid #4462aa; } .ds-dialog-body { padding: 16px; color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 14px; } .ds-dialog-foot { background: #1d2840; padding: 12px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-dialog-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: #3d63c7; color: #f8fafc; font: 700 14px Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-btn:hover { background: #4a6fd0; } .ds-dialog-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark field with blue-500 focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 280px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #d1d5db; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px 12px; background: #1f2937; border: 1px solid #4b5563; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; font: inherit; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #3b82f6; }

components.name: New Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-new { display: inline-block; background: #e0a23b; color: #1a1206; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Newspaper Ribbon
components.description: Parchment entry point to the newspaper sub-world.
components.css: .ds-ribbon { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1px; max-width: 260px; padding: 6px 12px 6px 16px; background: #efe6cf; color: #1c1a17; border: none; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-ribbon-kicker { font: 700 10px Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a2a1b; } .ds-ribbon-title { font: 400 15px 'Alfa Slab One', Georgia, serif; } .ds-ribbon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Kampánykörút looks like a campaign war room after dark. A full-bleed photograph of the place or the moment sits behind everything, dimmed to half brightness. On top of it floats one deep-navy frame (hq-navy at 92% opacity, 1200 × 750 on desktop, edge to edge on phones) that holds the whole game. Inside the frame, everything is screen light: slate text on navy, translucent glass panels drawn with 1px inset hairlines, and one royal campaign blue that marks the action you can take now. Results gold is held back until the count comes in.

The density is that of a working tool, not a poster. Controls are compact (30/40/50px heights), labels are bold Montserrat at small sizes, and panels are separated by hairlines and faint tint, not heavy shadows. Expression comes from the backdrop photography, the map, party colors and the occasional sub-world (the newspaper, the winter season), never from decorating the chrome.

The primary and selected-tab buttons are flat on purpose: no gloss, no blue glow. That choice is written into the theme source and is a standing rejection.
keyCharacteristics: One dark frame over a dimmed photographic backdrop
One action color (campaign blue); gold only for earned outcomes
Glass panels: translucent slate fill plus 1px inset hairline
Montserrat throughout, bold for every control
Party colors carry the data; the UI stays blue-slate so they read

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Campaign blue fills only the primary action and the selected tab. Everything else that is interactive stays glass or light. If two filled blue buttons share a view, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Earned Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only when the player has earned something: a result, an outcome, a milestone, something new. Never on chrome, navigation, or ordinary buttons.

rules.name: The Party Colors Own the Data Rule
rules.body: Maps, seat bars and vote shares use party colors. UI chrome never borrows a party hue, so no party is visually privileged by the interface.

rules.name: The Bold Controls Rule
rules.body: Every button, tab and link is weight 700. Body text never is, except strong inside news content.

rules.name: The Newsprint Stays in the Paper Rule
rules.body: The three serif faces load with the newspaper component and appear nowhere else.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface that sits on the frame gets a 1px inset hairline or a blue-50/10 border, not a drop shadow. Shadows mean "this floats above the frame".

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Blue never glows. Primary surfaces get a neutral black shadow only.

dos: Do build every button with @shared/ui/Button and pick a variant; don't hand-roll button styles.
Do put new panels on the glass recipe: translucent slate or blue-400/10 fill, 1px blue-50/10 border or inset hairline, 6–12px radius.
Do give interactive elements the 2px signal-blue focus ring offset against hq-navy.
Do expose data-variant, data-selected, data-surface and data-panel on new components so seasonal skins can reach them.
Do use slate-muted for secondary copy and chalk or ice-text for primary copy on dark.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for any ambient animation.
donts: Don't add gloss, gradients or a blue glow to primary or selected-tab buttons; they are flat on purpose.
Don't use results gold on chrome, navigation or ordinary actions.
Don't use party colors in UI chrome, or UI blue in data that party colors should own.
Don't use the newspaper serifs or parchment tones outside the newspaper.
Don't add a second sans-serif or a display face to the core UI.
Don't put drop shadows on surfaces that sit flat on the frame; use a hairline.
Don't introduce new raw hex panel colors; reuse panel-ink, panel-footer, modal-ink and the rule colors.
